summary: Backend testing of VelvetAI: 32/32 pytest tests passing across health, auth, characters (incl. 31 seeded), conversations, chat (incl. SSE streaming + OpenRouter LLM), images (graceful 502 from Fal.ai exhausted balance), voice (graceful 502 from ElevenLabs paid plan), scenarios (12), stories, live, roulette, media, and legacy /api/status. All endpoints respond with correct status codes, response shapes, and persisted data.

minor.issue: External Cloudflare/k8s ingress masks upstream 502 JSON responses with generic HTML 502 page. FastAPI returns correct JSON 502 with detail when hit via localhost:8001. Frontend calls via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL will receive HTML 502 instead of JSON detail. Consider returning 200 with {ok:false, error:...} payload OR a non-502 status code (e.g., 400/503) so the JSON body survives the edge proxy.
Returns 200 with {ok:false} for non-existent media (instead of 404). Inconsistent with other DELETE endpoints. Minor — not blocking.

When existing conversation found, returns it without dispatching an opening message. The first-ever creation does send opener — but spec says 'returns one assistant opening message' — verified working on fresh conversation only.

action_items: Consider returning non-502 (e.g., 200 with error payload, or 503) for Fal.ai/ElevenLabs failures so JSON detail survives Cloudflare ingress and frontend can show meaningful errors.
Optional: make DELETE /api/media/{id} return 404 for missing media for consistency.
Top up Fal.ai balance and upgrade ElevenLabs plan to enable image/voice generation in production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 617 lines — consider splitting routers into modules (auth, characters, chat, etc.) once it grows further.
Datetime persisted as ISO strings in some places and as datetime in others — already handled with _clean helper, but consider a single serialization layer.
_add_xp performs 3 DB round trips per call; could be optimized with a single update + level-calculation pipeline.
/api/chat/stream uses token in query string (necessary for EventSource) — acceptable but log scrubbing of query strings recommended.
Image avatar generation for newly created custom characters is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — will silently fail if Fal.ai balance exhausted (no retry or notification).
test_credentials: Tests register a fresh TEST_user_<uuid>@velvet.ai user on the fly each run. No pre-seeded credentials required. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty.
seed_data_creation: None — only TEST_-prefixed throwaway users + 1 TEST_CustomChar (deleted within suite).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully tested and passing. backend_test.py uses external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for most tests but localhost:8001 for /api/images/generate and /api/voice/tts because Cloudflare/k8s edge ingress rewrites upstream 502 responses to HTML — the FastAPI app itself correctly returns JSON 502 with detail. OpenRouter LLM key is working (chat/send and chat/stream both verified producing real replies). Fal.ai and ElevenLabs keys have no balance/free-tier — endpoints handle errors gracefully. Frontend testing not requested in this iteration.
rca of the issue: External 502 responses arrived as HTML instead of JSON. RCA: Cloudflare edge in front of the preview environment intercepts upstream HTTP 502 status codes and substitutes its own generic 'preview.emergentagent.com | 502: Bad gateway' HTML page. Confirmed by hitting http://localhost:8001/api/images/generate directly — returns clean JSON {detail: 'User is locked. Reason: Exhausted balance...'} with content-type application/json. The backend implementation (raising HTTPException(502, res['error'])) is correct. Mitigation: either (a) change error status from 502 to 400/503 to avoid edge rewrite, or (b) return 200 with structured error payload so frontend gets the detail.
